# Level 1 — nested leave-one-signer-out (generated by scripts/report_alphabet_nested.py)

Data: hauuto, 636 clips, 4 signers, 34 classes (29 letters + 5 tone marks); external QIPEDC letters 46 clips. Licence unknown, internal use only.
Protocol: nested LOSO: outer test signer, inner leave-one-signer-out validation over the 3 others. Candidates: MLP / BiGRU x epochs [20, 40, 80, 120]; seed 42.
